notes.108: Every rank builds the whole table for all ranks: base + (r < rem ? 1 : 0) rows each, starting at global row 1.
notes.110: rowStart is a GLOBAL row number. Rank 0 starts at 1, because row 0 is the fixed cold edge that nobody owns.
notes.114: Rank 0 has nobody above it. MPI_PROC_NULL makes a Sendrecv with it finish at once and do nothing.
notes.115: The last rank has nobody below it.
notes.128: How many values rank r sends in the Gatherv: its rows times n columns.
notes.129: Where rank r's rows land in rank 0's full grid: start row times n.
notes.132: myRows + 2 rows: local row 0 and local row myRows + 1 are the ghost rows.
notes.139: Fills ghost rows too. On rank 0 and the last rank the outer ghost is the real cold edge, and it is never overwritten.
notes.155: The only barrier in the file. It exists so the stopwatch starts at the same moment on every rank.
notes.164: Up-exchange: send my first owned row (local 1) up, receive the row above into my top ghost (local 0).
notes.167: Down-exchange: send my last owned row (local myRows) down, receive the row below into my bottom ghost.
notes.176: Convert local row to global row. is_fixed asks about the plate, so it needs the global row.
notes.182: Average of the 4 neighbours from cur. For localI = 1 or myRows this reads a ghost row.
notes.194: Every rank's largest change, combined with MPI_MAX and handed to every rank. No rank leaves until all have entered.
notes.199: Swap pointers, not data. cur now holds this iteration's result.
notes.208: Every rank sends its owned rows (from local row 1). Called by every rank, because every rank computes the same if condition.
notes.211: Only rank 0 has the full grid, so only rank 0 writes the frame.
notes.219: Every rank tests the same globalMax, so every rank decides to stop on the same iteration.

summaries.all: Every rank runs the same loop: refresh both ghost rows, compute its own rows, Allreduce the largest change, sometimes Gatherv a frame to rank 0, then decide to stop.
summaries.zero: Rank 0 owns the top band. Its up-exchange is with MPI_PROC_NULL, so only the down-exchange moves data. It also receives the Gatherv and writes the frames.
summaries.worker: Rank {r} swaps rows with rank {r} - 1 above it and with the rank below it (MPI_PROC_NULL if it is the last rank), computes its band, and joins the Allreduce and Gatherv.
